documentation: This file contains the dossier and briefing text for the two experimental scenarios.

techtrend.name: TechTrend Innovations
techtrend.briefing: You are the financial decision-maker for TechTrend Innovations, a technology startup developing AI-powered logistics solutions. The firm recently secured a Series A funding round, generating $500,000 in surplus funds. With annual revenue of $2 million, TechTrend faces high market volatility due to rapid technological shifts. Your task is to allocate these funds across three investment options to manage risk. The board has mandated a conservative investment strategy prioritizing financial stability to support R&D and a major product launch in 5 years. Review the Firm Dossier:

dossierItems.label: Strategic Priority
dossierItems.value: Extend runway to support R&D and product launch.

xyz.name: XYZ Manufacturing
xyz.briefing: You are part of the financial decision-makers for XYZ Manufacturing, a mid-sized firm specializing in industrial equipment. Recently, XYZ expanded into new markets, boosting annual revenue to $50 million but increasing exposure to economic fluctuations. With $1,000,000 in surplus funds, your task is to allocate these funds across three investment options. The board has mandated a conservative investment strategy prioritizing financial stability to support operations and future growth. Review the Firm Dossier:

dossierItems.label: Strategic Priority
dossierItems.value: Preserve capital and maintain liquidity for planned IoT investment.
